description: Technical checks across pages and logs. Pick with mode: hreflang = Hreflang across language versions, with the corrected tag set. Needs url. parameters = URL parameters and filters that waste crawl budget. duplicates = Duplicate and near-duplicate pages. Needs audit_id. extract = One value pulled from many pages. Needs urls. logs = Access logs: what Googlebot and AI crawlers really crawl, with IP verification. Needs log.

attribute.description: With selector: read this attribute instead of the text, for example href or content.

audit_id.description: Id of a completed site audit.

jsonld.description: A JSON-LD path: the @type, then the properties, for example Product.offers.price or Article.author.name.

log.description: Raw access log lines, one request per line.

regex.description: A regular expression; the first group is returned if there is one, otherwise the whole match.

selector.description: CSS selector, for example .price, h1 or link[rel=canonical].

sitemap_urls.description: Optional: the URLs from the site's sitemap, to find pages bots never crawl.

url.description: Full address of one language version of the page.

urls.description: Optional extra URLs, for example from server logs or Search Console.

name: technical
title: Technical SEO
